about: Tunable comparison tolerance (ADR-0004 §6): default, then gameTypes.<type>, then screens["<type>/<screen>"]. Measured 2026-10-04: main vs main is byte-identical on every screen of every fixture, twice, so the starting values sit just above zero noise: any differing pixel in any 16x16 block fails. Changing a value is a pipeline change the owner approves; put the measured noise in the PR. See docs/playtest/current-games.md.
